Name: Sebastian - New Hair and Moto Jacket
Author: ktruong
Description:
[b]Sebby makeover! [/b]After I married Sebastian I figured I could try making my first mod. I wanted to give him an urban hairstyle and some clothes that would suit his motorcycle hobby. Also added stubble to age make him look a bit more mature but kept his face pretty vanilla.

I hope you enjoy it!

[img]http://i65.tinypic.com/x5xve8.jpg[/img]

[u][b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b][/u]
1. Download and extract files
2. Open folder directory ...Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits and Stardew Valley\Content\Characters
3. Back up your Sebastian.xnb file (you can rename it to Sebastian_Original.xnb) in both the characters and portrait folders.
4. Copy and paste the new file into the respective folders
5. You are done! Enjoy the sexy mod!
